comment: Kaizo battle start conditions the ROM extractor cannot derive unambiguously (tools/rom/readers/maps.py trainer_start_conditions, plan K2b Ruling 8).

Keys are numeric trainer ids (the id in trainers.json); each value is {"trainer": the Kaizo ROM text name at that id (TEXT_BANK_NPC_TRAINER_NAMES), "condition": none | rain | hail | sandstorm | sun | fog | unknown}. The extractor checks the name against the ROM, so an id drift fails loudly.

Only trainers whose maps give more than one condition belong here; an entry may not contradict an unambiguous derivation. 'unknown' is written to trainers.json as is: the evidence does not settle the condition, and extract_rom prints every such trainer.

Evidence per entry: the ROM maps (d_test.narc header ids; map weather decoded by maps.weather_switch_conditions), the Kaizo docs sheet (sheet:row of the trainer header and its section header) and PKCalc pkcalc/src/js/data/flags.js (zip SHA-256 849733e6...): FLAGS_PK weather lists sun 518-570, rain 571-671, sand 672-707, hail 708-777, fog 778-836; a label in none of them has no PKCalc weather.

94 Taylor, 95 Jeffrey, 96 Allison: rain. ROM: header 371 only, yearly weather Route 212 South, rain on 365 of 366 days (Apr 30 none). Sheet: section Galactic Split:5 'Route 212 (PERMANENT RAIN)'; trainers Galactic Split:27 (Taylor), :17 (Jeffrey), :7 (party of ROM 96 Allison, header text misnamed 'Jeffrey'). PKCalc rain: flags.js:632 (Taylor), :630 (Jeffrey), :631 (Allison).

732-734 Taylor and 736-738 Allison (Vs. Seeker rematches of 94 and 96, gVsSeekerRematchData): rain. ROM: their base trainer's header 371, rain on 365 of 366 days. Sheet: no rematch rows; the area's section Galactic Split:5 'Route 212 (PERMANENT RAIN)'. PKCalc: no rematch labels; the base trainers' rain entries flags.js:632 (Taylor), :631 (Allison).

519 Europa: hail. ROM: headers 210 (hail), 216 (none). Sheet: Galactic Split:997 'GalacticF Europa', section Galactic Split:995 'CORONET HIGHLANDS OUTSIDE 2 (HAIL)'. PKCalc 'Galactic Europa #3' hail: flags.js:769.

562 Terra, 572 Luna: fog; 581 Neptune, 606 Triton: rain; 582 Oberon: hail. ROM (since 2026-11-14, E3 batch 5): their tag battles sit in scripts_empty (scr_seq 401), whose entries 9-11 the coord events of the Coronet Highlands headers run: 211 MT_CORONET_OUTSIDE_SOUTH (Oberon, Titania), 212 MT_CORONET_4F_ROOMS_1_AND_2 and 250 (Terra, Luna), 214 MT_CORONET_5F (Neptune, Triton). Each of these five also has a second placement, STARK_MOUNTAIN_ROOM_2, so its maps give more than one condition. 583 Titania's only header is 211 (hail): the ROM settles it, so it left this list. Sheet: Galactic Split:975 (Terra) and :985 (Luna) in section :933 'CORONET HIGHLANDS ROOM 1 (FOG)'; :1111 (Neptune) and :1121 (Triton) in section :1099 'CORONET HIGHLANDS ROOM 3 (RAIN)'; :912 (Oberon) and :922 (Titania) in section :799 'CORONET HIGHLANDS OUTSIDE 1 (HAIL)'. PKCalc: 'Galactic Terra #5' fog flags.js:815, 'Galactic Luna #5' fog :816, 'Galactic Neptune #3' rain :658, 'Galactic Triton #3' rain :659, 'Galactic Oberon #2' hail :767, 'Galactic Titania' hail :768.

861 Riley: fog; 863 Marley: rain; 865 Cheryl: hail (tag partners in Coronet Highlands, placed by the same scripts_empty entries as the line above, and each also on header BATTLEGROUND, so their maps give more than one condition). ROOM 3 (RAIN)'; :902 'Trainer Cheryl (TAG PARTNER)' in section :799 '... OUTSIDE 1 (HAIL)'. unknown, the evidence does not settle them; the user's answers (2026-11-07) settle each in data/kaizo/overrides.toml [area.<id>] weather (509, 559 and 649 there as the Galactic HQ Trick Room fight). 318 Fantina and 676 Corbin left this list on 2026-11-14 (E3 batch 5): the shared-script join gives each one ROM condition.

318 Fantina (Hearthome Gym; fix round 2; corrected 2026-11-07). ROM: 318 is placed on headers 95 (weather 28: none) and 100 (none); the join also lists header 89 (fog) only because 89 shares script file 96 (StartTrainerBattle 318 at offsets 363 and 543) with 95. Header 89 does not battle 318: only header 95 has the Fantina object, and nothing in 89 runs that script. No warp in the ROM leads into header 100. Sheet: Fantina Split:452 'Leader Fantina' (section :449 'Hearthome Gym Room #7', no weather tag). PKCalc: 'Leader Fantina' is in no weather list (flags.js:516-836). Unknown. Entry removed 2026-11-14 (E3 batch 5): the join now places a shared script file's battles only on headers whose events or init scripts run the entry (tools/rom/readers/maps.py trainer_maps), so header 89 drops out and the ROM gives none unambiguously; overrides area.318 (user, 2026-11-07) agrees.

325 Morton, 343 Fantina? (Hearthome Gym; fix round 1). A trainer id is fought once (its trainer flag), in the room where the player meets it first, so the condition is the first room's only if the room order is fixed. ROM: 325 is an object event in header 89 (fog) and header 93 (weather 26: none); 343 is a script battle of header 91 (script 98 offset 365, none) and an object event in headers 94 (fog) and 97 (none). The warps (zone_event.narc warp events): the entrance header 88's warp tiles to 90 and 91 are walled in (corrected 2026-11-07; an earlier note read them as direct warps), so the rooms run 88 -> 89 -> 90 -> ... -> 95 in a fixed order; the header 91 battle with 343 is forced (script 98; the bollards open only after a win). Sheet: Fantina Split:271 'Policeman Morton (FOG, Also Appears in Room 5)' (section :258 Room #1); :339 'Leader Fantina ? (Also Appears in Room 6, Separate Fight)' (section :336 Room #3, no tag). PKCalc: 'Policeman Morton' fog flags.js:781; 'Leader Fantina?' in no weather list. Left unknown here: one id records one condition, and which fight counts is the user's call.
